qa.title: Recording and Transcription Pipeline
qa.question: What are the steps involved in processing a recorded meeting?
qa.answer: The steps involved in processing a recorded meeting include recording the audio, transcribing the audio to text using Whisper, summarizing the text into key points and Q&A, and finally storing the summary in a database.

qa.title: AI Workflow
qa.question: How does the AI workflow process a recorded meeting?
qa.answer: The AI workflow processes a recorded meeting by first transcribing the audio to text, then summarizing the text into key points and Q&A, and finally storing the summary in a database for future reference.

qa.title: Whisper Transcription
qa.question: What is Whisper used for in the meeting processing pipeline?
qa.answer: Whisper is used to transcribe the recorded audio into text.

qa.title: Database Storage
qa.question: Where is the final summary stored after processing a recorded meeting?
qa.answer: The final summary is stored in a database for future reference.
